info.title: Yield Guardian
info.description:
Yield Guardian API: semiconductor yield investigation on real fab data (SECOM, WM-811K).

* Errors are RFC 9457 `application/problem+json` (schema `Problem`).
* Investigator events stream as server-sent events (schema `InvestigationEvent`).
* Run events stream as server-sent events (schema `RunEvent`).
* Runs and uploads need no sign-in. Actions (investigations, decisions, work orders) need a
  session cookie and the `X-CSRF-Token` header (see `/session`).

get.description: Liveness: the process answers.
Readiness: bundles verified, database reachable, services loaded.
The measured-results table. A row's estimate is null until it is measured on held-out data.

post.description:
Materialise the input and start computing every stage now. Follow it on `events_url`.
With a session, the run is recorded in its workspace ("Your work").
A new run of exactly the same input items; the earlier run is kept as it is.

get.description: Real situations found in the data by fixed rules over live computations.
Real WM-811K die layouts to draw a defect on (every die starts as pass).

The run's full state: every stage with its result and every listed alarm. Another
workspace's run answers 404, as a missing one does.

Two runs side by side: each stage's status and alarms, the units and wafers flagged, and
what changed from the first to the second.

The run's computed results as CSV: risk, T², SPE and chart level per unit, pattern and
unknown flag per wafer, and every listed alarm.

200.description: One row per sensor unit, wafer and alarm (column `record`).

get.description:
One unit's control-chart result with `z` (every monitored sensor's standardised
reading); the run and its events carry `z` for the first 200 units only.
Stored events after Last-Event-ID, then live ones; the stream closes after `run_done`.

200.description: Server-sent events. `event` is the event type, `id` its `seq`, `data` the JSON event.

post.description:
Parse and validate a sensor or wafer file and keep it, in this workspace, as long as the
workspace (24 h without a session). What is wrong inside the file comes back as issues
(errors block the run); only an unreadable file is refused.

get.description: The header row only, ready to fill in.

Real data in the upload format: real SECOM units the risk model never saw, or every die
of one real WM-811K demo lot. The source and licence ride in `X-Data-Attribution` and a
`Link` header (rel cite-as); a workbook also has an About sheet.

SECOM unit alarms (AL-<unit>-<kind>) over every unit, newest first. The status of each is
this workspace's own: investigating or closed only by its own investigations.
Units in time order.

post.description:
Start a live investigation of this workspace. Follow it on GET /investigations/{id}/events.

A `run_alarm` trigger (`<run_id>:<alarm_id>`) needs a run this workspace may open and its
alarm (404 otherwise).

them, on the first page, the product's examples: recorded runs every visitor sees.
Another workspace's investigation answers 404, as a missing one does.
Stored events after Last-Event-ID, then live ones; the stream closes after the `end` event.

post.description:

decision; 409 until the report is written.

Another workspace's work order answers 404, as a missing one does.

get.description:
Every action taken in this workspace, and those about the product's example (marked
`example`), newest first.
Wafers of the demo set (a derived WM-811K subset with attribution).
The real wafer shown on the home page, with the rule that picked it.
Pattern excursion tests and the stacked failure map of one lot.
Full-text search of the curated open-access literature.
Pattern-to-cause hypotheses with their sources.

post.description:
Ask about the plant data. Answers cite evidence; numbers are checked against it. The
tools read for this workspace only: a run or investigation in the context must be its own
(or of no workspace), else 404 as for a missing one.

post.description:
This device's session and workspace, made on its first visit (no sign-up). Called on every
page load: it also renews the cookie, which lasts as long as the device session.

"Try as engineer": this device becomes an engineer (approve, reject, ask) and keeps its
workspace.
Back to visitor: the engineer or admin role ends, this device keeps its workspace.

post.description:
A single-use code that attaches another device to this workspace, for 10 minutes. A new
code replaces the last unused one.
Attach this device to the workspace that made the code. The code is then used up.
Move this device to a new, empty workspace; other devices keep the old one.

UnknownScore.title: UnknownScore
UnknownScore.description:
Mahalanobis score of the CNN embedding; above the threshold, the wafer is an unknown pattern.

The score is the smallest squared Mahalanobis distance from the L2-normalised embedding to a
class mean (shared Ledoit-Wolf covariance). The threshold accepts 95% of validation wafers.
